notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wB2-016) and unreviewed; no human review and no hardware run is claimed. The device is simulated R0 (world.sim): there is no hardware backend and no operator-required limit; the only envelope is the action space the Gymnasium bridge derives from the environment's one-dimensional Box(-10, 10) (python/tds_environments/cartpole_tds_env.py:30-35). MOCK PATH: the card prefers upstream-sim, which is the sim backend that GymnasiumDriver.open_native would serve with gymnasium.make("CartpolePyTinyDiffSim-v0") (the bridge falls back to the legacy gym package); that path needs the compiled pytinydiffsim extension and the tds_environments registration import, which are not installed where the gate runs, so it was not run. The gate runs the package's pure Python fake (fake.py), an analytic cart-pole never compared with the upstream engine; its random stream differs from C++ std::rand, and the TimeLimit wrapper that gym.make adds (max_episode_steps 200), rendering, and get_state/set_state are not reproduced (the fidelity gaps say so). COVERAGE: one device class, the first confirmed entry symbol CartpolePyTinyDiffSim-v0; the second entry symbol tds_environments.reacher_tds_env:ReacherPyTinyDiffSim (ReacherPyTinyDiffSim-v0) is not bound, and the card's models[0] (data/swimmer/swimmer05/model.xml) is a scene model not used by this driver. WARNINGS: the five expected Gymnasium-family warnings only: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the pending seed without a native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs (ticks, action.values[*], and the seed of cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1); no G4 warning was raised. The catalogue classes used are cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 only, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the last check printed.
